nodes.description: Mapping from account to array of InstrumentPosition structs holding staked put positions.
Immutable IProtocolAdapter instance target of delegatecalls into the venue adapter.
Immutable IAmmAdapter instance target of delegateBuyLp delegatecall.
Immutable Chainlink AggregatorV3Interface used to read the current WBTC price.
Immutable address of the Hegic options contract used for exercise calls.
Payable address of the uniswap adapter contract.
Immutable IRibbonFactory used to resolve the venue adapter address at construction.
Immutable IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for all swaps and liquidity operations.
Immutable WBTC/DIGG sushiswap pair used to mint and transfer LP tokens.
Immutable WBTC ERC20 token used for approvals and allowance checks.
Immutable DIGG ERC20 token used for approvals during liquidity provision.
Reads latestRoundData from the price provider and scales the price by 10**10.
Computes wbtc size, expected digg out, premium, total cost, current price and expiry for a given ETH amount.
Payable entry point that delegate-buys LP on the uniswap adapter, buys a put, and refunds leftover ETH to msg.sender.
Payable nonReentrant function that delegate-purchases the Hegic put and records a new InstrumentPosition.
External nonReentrant function that delegate-exercises the holder's put option and marks it exercised.
View helper that delegate-queries the exercise profit of a position.
View helper that queries the adapter for whether a position can be exercised.
Returns the constant instrument name 'wbtc/digg-staked-put'.
Payable public function converting incoming ETH to WBTC then buying LP for msg.sender.
Internal routine that swaps WBTC for DIGG, adds liquidity and transfers LP tokens to the trader.
Internal swap of ETH for a token through the router using a block.timestamp based deadline.
Internal token-to-token swap through the router, approving max allowance when needed.
Internal liquidity provision to the router with zero min amounts and a timestamp deadline.
Pure math computing the optimal swap amount for minimal leftover funds (Alpha Homora formula).
View that reads pair reserves and computes expected DIGG out and trade amount.
Caller controlled address used to key positions and receive ETH refunds and profits.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for option expiry and router deadlines.
delegatecall into IAmmAdapter.buyLp which executes arbitrary adapter code in this contract's context.
delegatecall into IProtocolAdapter.purchase executing venue adapter logic in this contract's storage context.
External staticcall to the adapter to query exercise profit.
delegatecall into IProtocolAdapter.exercise transferring exercised profits to a recipient.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) sending remaining contract ETH to the caller.
Low-level external swap/addLiquidity calls into the sushiswap router transferring value or tokens.
External call to the Chainlink aggregator latestRoundData() returning a raw int256 price.
BuyInstrumentParams calldata supplied by the caller to buyInstrument.
Caller supplied position id used to index instrumentPositions.
Storage pointer to the InstrumentPosition being exercised.
Local accumulator of the exercise profit returned by the adapter.
Caller supplied ETH amount used by buyLp and validated against msg.value.
Caller supplied account address used to look up a position's profit.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account that initiates the payable buyInstrument flow.
msg.sender is the recipient of the leftover ETH transfer performed at the end of buyInstrument.
msg.sender indexes instrumentPositions to select the position to exercise.
Caller supplied account is stored in a local variable then used to read positions.
Option expiry returned by getInputs is computed from block.timestamp plus timePeriod.
buyPutFromAdapter requires block.timestamp < params.expiry before purchasing.
Swap deadline is derived from block.timestamp plus deadlineBuffer.
Token swap deadline is derived from block.timestamp plus deadlineBuffer.
addLiquidity deadline is derived from block.timestamp plus deadlineBuffer.
buyInstrument calls buyPutFromAdapter to create the position.
buyInstrument delegatecalls the uniswap adapter buyLp which can execute external calls.
buyInstrument sends remaining balance to msg.sender after external delegatecall interactions.
buyPutFromAdapter delegatecalls adapter.purchase which may transfer value externally.
exercisePosition queries the adapter profit via an external staticcall before effects are applied.
exercisePosition delegatecalls adapter.exercise to transfer profits to holder before marking exercised.
exerciseProfit staticcalls the adapter profit computation.
getInputs calls getCurrentPrice to obtain the strike price.
getCurrentPrice performs an external call to the Chainlink aggregator.
The immutable adapter state variable is the delegatecall target for purchase.
The immutable adapter state variable is the delegatecall target for exercise.
The immutable adapter state variable is the staticcall target for profit queries.
The immutable iUniswapAdapter state variable is the delegatecall target for buyLp.
optionsAddress is passed into the adapter profit query.
optionsAddress is passed into the adapter exercise call.
instrumentPositions storage is read to load the position being exercised.
instrumentPositions storage is read to compute a position's profit.
instrumentPositions storage is read to determine exercisability.
instrumentPositions storage is appended to when a new put position is created.
buyLp converts incoming ETH to WBTC via convertEthToToken.
buyLp delegates the LP purchase to the internal _buyLp routine.
_buyLp swaps WBTC for DIGG via convertTokenToToken.
_buyLp adds liquidity through addLiquidity.
_convertEthToToken performs an external swapExactETHForTokens call to the router.
_convertTokenToToken performs an external swapExactTokensForTokens call to the router.
The sushiswapRouter state variable is the target of the external swap calls.
The wbtcDiggSushiswap pair state variable is used to transfer LP tokens to the trader.
expectedDiggOut calls getSwapAmt whose fixed point math multiplies and divides reserves.
exercisePosition loads the storage position struct into a local pointer.
exercisePosition accumulates the adapter returned profit into the local totalProfit.
buyInstrument reads the caller supplied BuyInstrumentParams calldata.
buyPutFromAdapter reads the caller supplied BuyInstrumentParams calldata.
buyLp uses the amt parameter to convert ETH into WBTC.
exercisePosition indexes the caller's position array using the positionID parameter.

normalization_plan.reason: The calldata struct parameter is only meaningful as the input to the buyInstrument entry point.
positionID is a caller supplied index used only inside exercisePosition.
The storage pointer local is a temporary view of the position consumed by exercisePosition.
The profit accumulator local exists solely to hold the result used inside exercisePosition.
amt is the caller supplied ETH amount validated and converted inside buyLp.
account is only used to index instrumentPositions within exerciseProfit.
